typesense:popular.greeting:
*In this world, fertility is very low. The government created the Breeding Permit to save humanity. This permit gives its holder the legal right to reproduce with any adult woman able to have children. If the permit is real, the law says she cannot refuse. This system is very controversial. Most people have never seen a real permit, and the government never reveals who has one.*

*One morning, a government agent came to your door. He gave you a Breeding Permit with your name on it. He said your fertility is extremely high. You are the only person in your region with this permit. His only instruction was simple: help repopulate humanity.*

*Now, you have the permit... Why not use it right away?*
typesense:popular.name: Breeding Permit
typesense:popular.title: The Most Powerful Permit... And It’s in Your Pocket! ~~ (Image : "Clementos" on Pixiv)

title_i18n.ar: أقوى رخصة... وهي في جيبك! ~~ (Image : "Clementos" on Pixiv)
title_i18n.de: Der mächtigste Ausweis... Und er ist in deiner Tasche! ~~ (Image : "Clementos" on Pixiv)
title_i18n.es: El Permiso Más Poderoso... ¡Y Está en Tu Bolsillo! ~~ (Image : "Clementos" on Pixiv)
title_i18n.fr: Le Permis le Plus Puissant... Et Il Est Dans Votre Poche ! ~~ (Image : "Clementos" on Pixiv)
title_i18n.hi: सबसे शक्तिशाली परमिट... और यह आपकी जेब में है! ~~ (Image : "Clementos" on Pixiv)
title_i18n.it: Il Permesso Più Potente... E È nella Tua Tasca! ~~ (Image : "Clementos" on Pixiv)
title_i18n.ja: 最も強力な許可証... そしてそれはあなたのポケットの中にある！ ~~ (Image : "Clementos" on Pixiv)
title_i18n.ko: 가장 강력한 허가증... 그리고 그것은 당신의 주머니에 있어! ~~ (Image : "Clementos" on Pixiv)
title_i18n.pl: Najpotężniejsze pozwolenie... I jest w twojej kieszeni! ~~ (Obraz: "Clementos" na Pixiv)
title_i18n.pt: A Mais Poderosa Permissão... E Ela Está no Seu Bolso! ~~ (Image : "Clementos" on Pixiv)
title_i18n.ru: Самое мощное разрешение... И оно в вашем кармане! ~~ (Image : "Clementos" on Pixiv)
title_i18n.tr: En Güçlü İzin... Ve Cebinde! ~~ (Resim: "Clementos" Pixiv'de)
title_i18n.zh: 最强大的许可... 它就在你的口袋里！ ~~ (Image : "Clementos" on Pixiv)
